summary: Mainland-edition appendix (written 2016-07) reviewing the 2014 A-share call and restating method: wait for patterns to complete (等待是一种艺术), read volume-price changes to infer the main player. It then shows A-share chart examples with measured-move targets: time-wave symmetry turning points (上证 9 weeks / 12 days), flag and triangle continuation targets (亚夏股份, 上证50), and top patterns with measured drops (山东黄金 三尊头, 中金黄金 M头, 中航三鑫 M头, 天津信息 头肩顶, 宁波东力 头肩顶, 长江电力 收敛三角形头部), plus 乐普医疗 flag and W bottom.

patterns.structure: Count bars of the prior swing; a turn (变盘) is expected when the following swing reaches the same bar count (上证周线 9周/9周; 上证日线 12天/12天, 第12天变盘).
patterns.entry: At the symmetric bar count, watch for the turn; book: upward turn completing the bottom while support 2822-2922 holds.
patterns.stop: Do not break the important support zone (上证 2822-2922).

target.worked_example: 上证周线: 9 weeks down from 3684.57 to 2638.30 area, then 9th week turning point at 2016-07-07.

confirmation: Price confirms by breaking out in the direction of the turn.

patterns.structure: Leg from a low to the flag high; flag/consolidation pulls back to a flag low; target = flag low + (flag high - leg low).
patterns.entry: Breakout of the flag (implied by charts).
invalidation: 假突破 after reaching the target (乐普医疗).

patterns.structure: Prior up-leg from low to high, then a converging triangle; target = triangle low + prior leg height.
Three peaks over a neckline; head-and-shoulders top is a triple top whose middle peak is highest; triple top need not be H&S. Measure from the head (highest) high to the neckline.
patterns.entry: Break of the neckline (break point labelled on charts, e.g., 44, 35.3, 13.6).

patterns.structure: Two peaks over a neckline; measure top-to-neckline and project from the breakdown point.
Triangle at a top; measure high to triangle low and project from breakdown.
patterns.entry: Breakdown of the lower triangle line.
invalidation: 破底翻 near the target marks the end of the decline (长江电力).

patterns.stop: Not stated; later 破线 (trendline break) marked as exit.
invalidation: 破线 of the rising line after the target.

rules.rule: Long-term: the 6124 high should be revisited or exceeded within 10 years; 2016 is year 9 so low-level accumulation has limited risk (contrarian entry).
rules.quote_zh: 就长线的结构来看，6124的高点十年内会再来一次甚至突破，今年2016年已是第九年，因此A股低档布局风险有限，又一次人弃我取的进场时机

rules.rule: Used the wave measured-move (波段涨幅满足) to exit near the top after April 2015.
rules.quote_zh: 2015年四月以后也利用波段涨幅满足掌握高点成功逃顶

rules.rule: Don't trade what you can't read; wait for the pattern to complete — big swings are waited for; volume and price changes signal the entry because the main player trades real money.
rules.quote_zh: 所谓看不懂不做，行情并非随时都能看得懂，必须等待型态完成结构完整才容易做后续的判断，“等待是一种艺术”，大波段行情都是等出来的，当型态完成后，量与价的变化会告诉你进场时机

rules.rule: Reading volume-price structure reveals the main player's direction and intent.
rules.quote_zh: 因为主力作价是真金白银的进场操作，所以量必然会有变化，量的变化就会牵动价的波动，因此研判量价变化的结构便能判读主力动向与意图

rules.rule: Symmetric time-wave (9th week) is a long-term turning point; as long as 2822-2922 support holds, downside risk is limited.
rules.quote_zh: 上证正达对称时间波第九周的变盘转折，这是逾半年底型态的长线转折，往上变盘后完成底部进入主升段起涨的机率相当高，只要注意不再跌破2822点至2922点重要的支撑区即可，低档风险有限，往上空间无限

rules.rule: H&S top = triple top, but triple top ≠ H&S (head must be the highest middle peak); measure from the head high to the neckline.
rules.quote_zh: 头肩顶=三尊头 三尊头不=头肩顶（因为头在中间最高） 以头部高点至颈线的距离的方式做计算

worked_examples.outcome: hit target, then 假突破 and decline

worked_examples.pattern: 收敛三角形头部 + 破底翻
worked_examples.outcome: hit target area; 破底翻 at 11.13

quantifiable: Measured drop for tops: target = breakdown_price - (pattern_high - neckline); measured rise for flags/triangles: target = consolidation_low + (prior_leg_high - prior_leg_low).
Time symmetry: count bars of prior swing (N); flag a potential turn at bar N of the subsequent swing (±1).
Head-and-shoulders requires middle peak highest; otherwise classify as triple top; measure from the highest peak to neckline in both cases.
ambiguities: Breakdown point used in measured drops is the neckline-break price (e.g. 44 vs neckline 40.2; 13.4 vs triangle low 12.7), not the neckline itself — the book applies the distance from the break price; the exact break price definition (close vs line value) is not stated.
M top 中金黄金 uses 17 as the top though the higher high label (~18.11) appears; which peak to measure from is not explained.
No stops are stated for any example in this appendix.
Time-wave symmetry: no rule for choosing the start bar of the count.
